rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE A.E. INGERSOLL TRUST EREATED FEBRUARY 15, 1962
rulings.Calendar Matter: Petition For Termination Of Trust
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. 1) The judicial officer is to review and determine whether venue is proper in San Francisco County and whether this petition should be filed in Los Angeles County. Under Probate Code section 17005(a), the proper venue is the principal place of the administration of the trust. Under section 17002(a), the principal place of administration of the trust is the usual place where the day-to-day activity of the trust is carried on by the trustee or its representative who is primarily responsible for the administration of the trust. According to the supplement on file, the trustee bank's representative primarily responsible for the administration of the trust is in Westlake Village, Los Angels County. The bank's trust manager who verified the petition and supplement is also in Westlake Village, Los Angeles County. The 1997 class action against the bank (CGC-97-984497) re the bank's excessive trustee fees cited in the petition does not necessarily support venue for this trust case. 2) If venue is proper in San Francisco County, the judicial officer is to review and determine whether the petition as supplemented provided sufficient facts in support of the Court's findings necessary to terminate the trust under section 15408(a) or 15409(a) (or alternatively under section 15403 in light of all the beneficiaries' consents on file). The current trust value is $293,552. Last year, the trust only paid $6,383 expenses out of the principal balance, and it may take many years to reduce or exhaust the principal. Article I-(7) of the trust expresses the settlor's intent that the trust "shall continue in perpetuity for the charitable organizations and purposes", consisting with the settlor's intent to preserve principal by only allowing the trustee to distribute income. The trustee has the right to terminate the trust without requiring court approval under section 15408(b) when the trust principal balance is reduced to $100,000 from the present balance of $293,552. The trustee did not request modification of the trust, rather than termination, to allow the trustee to distribute not only income, but also principal in the trustee's discretion. The trustee has the right to resign and petition for appointment of a successor trustee willing to take over the administration under the trust's existing terms, as provided in Article V-(4) of the trust. PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear personally or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. For an audio-only appearance through Zoom, call 1-669-254-5252 and key in meeting ID "160 225 4765#", then participant ID "0#", then password "514879#". (Toll rates may apply).) The Court prefers that counsel and parties appearing by video input their first and last name into the "Your Name" dialogue box. rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JIMMY BUCKLEY
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/21/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) Beverly Cline, decedent's sister, has higher priority to act as administrator. A written declination must be filed by or on behalf of an individual who has higher priority than the petitioner for issuance of letters of administration but does not desire to act. If the necessary renunciation or declination is not filed, the petition must indicate the reason (LRSF 14.24). 2) No Confidential Statement of Birth Date and Driver's License Number (Form DE-147S) has been filed (LRSF 14.18.E). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 09/08/2026 to avoid additional continuance.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JOANNE KANZAWA
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Grant without hearing, although item 3e(3) of the petition should have been checked, not 3e(2), as the petitioner is an heir, not a beneficiary under a will. Status of closing the estate will be set for 2/14/2028. The administrator must file either a petition for final distribution or a petition for approval of a report of status of administration pursuant to Prob. C. Section 12200 (requesting additional time for estate administration) at least two weeks before 2/14/2028. Appearance will be required on 2/14/2028 if no petition has been filed.
